newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.

text.p: A solid supply of dollars helped the Bangladesh taka to close firmer at 42.5450/5460 to the U.S. currency in interbank trading, against the previous close of 42.5460/5470, dealers said.
The taka was quoted at 42.5460/5480 to the dollar in early trade but edged up later with huge dollar selling offers from a large state-owned bank.
"The market saw higher demand (for dollars) than on Sunday but an increased supply strained the U.S. currency," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished flat at 8.0 percent to 8.5 percent, dealers said.
